title: Filipino-Style Pork Bites with a Kiss of Bitter
description: Crispy pork bites infused with the flavors of the Philippines and a hint of bitterness. Perfect for a quick snack or appetizer.

ingredients.name: Filipino-style breading
ingredients.notes: See notes for homemade breading recipe

instructions: In a bowl, mix together the pork cubes, Filipino-style breading, bitter melon, bread crumbs, egg, salt, and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the pork mixture into the oil and flatten slightly.
Cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until the bottoms are golden brown.
Transfer the pork bites to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until cooked through.
Serve hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
